kind: staged composite: real photograph of the car + generated setting

setting.input: the whole Patton main/l photograph of each car
setting.direction: Alex's concept boards __CONCEPTS/2 (images 75-77): car on a low dark platform in a vast hazy industrial hall at night
setting.prompt_template: Keep the car exactly as it is ... pixel for pixel. Replace ONLY the surroundings ... a vast, dark industrial hall at night used for a private auction ... low, wide, matte charcoal steel platform about 20 cm high ... Grade the surroundings desaturated cool charcoal with faint warm highlights; the car keeps its true colour ... No text, letters, numbers, logos, signage, people, props, gold, neon or lens flare. (68: remove the two flanking cars; 41: keep both cars)

car.method: silhouette from pixelcut on the original; registered to the car in the generated frame by bbox scale+offset with a local search (see hall-registration.json: scale, tx, ty, residual); original pixels composited back, edge feather 1.6px

disclosure: captioned on the page as staged; the lot gallery uses unaltered photographs
brief: BRIEF.md decisions 3 and 7; reinstated 2026-10-05 after Alex rated the as-is photos 1/10 and supplied concept boards

revision_2026-10-06.why: Alex: the earlier composites were crooked (cars off their platforms, tyres hanging in the air). The car had been re-registered onto a generated frame whose own car was drawn in a different perspective.
revision_2026-10-06.method: Ideogram v4.5 edit on the ORIGINAL Patton photo, mask = everything except the car (edit_precision high), so the hall and platform are painted around the car where it actually stands; the original car pixels are then laid back on top; the frame is scaled uniformly to 2528 wide and padded by edge replication to 2528x1696. car-cut-<id>.webp is regenerated in the same coordinates.
revision_2026-10-06.references: Valour, SLR, 300 SL Kindig, 612 TR, Ford GT: the lot's previous hall as reference. Miura, Cobra, Pantera: the Valour hall as reference. 2025 33 Stradale, SF90, 1967 33 Stradale, 300 SLR pair: no reference (a reference pulled the framing).
revision_2026-10-06.cleanup: 300 SLR frame: a generated background figure removed by inpainting (no people).
revision_2026-10-06.not_changed: assets/v6/plate-*.jpg and assets/v6/car-*.webp (the v6/v7 hall walk) are untouched.
